name: singha-auctions-backend
description: Singha Auctions V2 — backend (NestJS API + BullMQ worker). Supabase-backed, Railway-hostable.

scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run test
scripts.supabase:deploy: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @singha/database exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.test:db: node scripts/with-ephemeral-db.mjs bash -c "pnpm db:migrate:deploy && pnpm --filter @singha/database run test"
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/with-ephemeral-db.mjs bash -c "pnpm turbo run build --filter=@singha/api && pnpm db:migrate:deploy && node scripts/e2e-data-core.mjs"
